blocks.en: ABSTRACT
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: By transferring knowledge from large, diverse, task-agnostic datasets, modern machine learning models can solve specific downstream tasks either zero-shot or with small task-specific datasets to a high level of performance. While this capability has been demonstrated in other fields such as computer vision, natural language processing or speech recognition, it remains to be shown in robotics, where the generalization capabilities of the models are particularly critical due to the difficulty of collecting real-world robotic data. We argue that one of the keys to the success of such general robotic models lies with open-ended task-agnostic training, combined with high-capacity architectures that can absorb all of the diverse, robotic data. In this paper, we present a model class, dubbed Robotics Transformer, that exhibits promising scalable model properties. We verify our conclusions in a study of different model classes and their ability to generalize as a function of the data size, model size, and data diversity based on a large-scale data collection on real robots performing real-world tasks. The project’s website and videos can be found at robotics-transformer1.github.io
blocks.zh: 通过从庞大、多样化且任务无关的数据集中迁移知识，现代机器学习模型能够以零样本（zero-shot）方式或仅利用少量的任务特定数据集，在特定的下游任务上达到极高的性能水平。尽管这一能力已在计算机视觉、自然语言处理或语音识别等其他领域得到印证，但在机器人领域仍有待证实；而由于采集现实世界机器人数据的困难性，模型的泛化能力在机器人学中显得尤为关键。我们认为，此类通用机器人模型成功的关键之一在于开放式的任务无关训练，并结合能够吸收所有多样化机器人数据的高容量架构。在本文中，我们提出了一类名为Robotics Transformer的模型，该模型展现出了极具前景的可扩展模型特性。基于在真实机器人执行现实世界任务过程中所收集的大规模数据集，我们研究了不同模型类别及其泛化能力随数据规模、模型大小和数据多样性变化的函数关系，从而验证了我们的结论。该项目的网站及视频可在 robotics-transformer1.github.io 查阅。

blocks.en: 1 INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 1 引言

blocks.en: End-to-end robotic learning, with either imitation or reinforcement, typically involves collecting task-specific data in either single-task (Kalashnikov et al., 2018; Zhang et al., 2018) or multitask (Kalashnikov et al., 2021b; Jang et al., 2021) settings that are narrowly tailored to the tasks that the robot should perform. This workflow mirrors the classic approach to supervised learning in other domains, such as computer vision and NLP, where task-specific datasets would be collected, labeled, and deployed to solve individual tasks, with little interplay between the tasks themselves. Recent years have seen a transformation in vision, NLP, and other domains, away from siloed, smallscale datasets and models and towards large, general models pre-trained on broad, large datasets. The keys to the success of such models lie with open-ended task-agnostic training, combined with high-capacity architectures that can absorb all of the knowledge present in large-scale datasets. If a model can “sponge up” experience to learn general patterns in language or perception, then it can bring them to bear on individual tasks more efficiently. While removing the need for large taskspecific datasets is appealing generally in supervised learning, it is even more critical in robotics, where datasets might require engineering-heavy autonomous operation or expensive human demonstrations. We therefore ask: can we train a single, capable, large multi-task backbone model on data consisting of a wide variety of robotic tasks? And does such a model enjoy the benefits observed in other domains, exhibiting zero-shot generalization to new tasks, environments, and objects?
blocks.zh: 无论是通过模仿还是强化，端到端机器人学习通常涉及在单任务（Kalashnikov et al., 2018; Zhang et al., 2018）或多任务（Kalashnikov et al., 2021b; Jang et al., 2021）设置下收集任务特定数据，而这些设置严格局限于机器人需要执行的具体任务。这一工作流程契合了计算机视觉和NLP等其他领域监督学习的经典方法：收集针对特定任务的数据集、打标签并用于解决单一任务，而任务本身之间几乎没有协同交互。近年来，视觉、NLP等领域发生了一场变革，摆脱了孤立、小规模的数据集和模型，转向在广泛的大规模数据集上预训练的大型通用模型。此类模型成功的关键在于开放式的任务无关训练，并结合能够吸收大规模数据集中全部知识的高容量架构。如果一个模型能够像“海绵”一样吸取经验以学习语言或感知中的通用模式，它便能更高效地将这些模式运用于各项具体任务。虽然免除对大规模任务特定数据集的需求在监督学习中通常极具吸引力，但在机器人领域则更为关键，因为机器人数据集的构建往往需要繁重工程支持的自主运行或昂贵的人工示教。因此，我们提出这样一个问题：我们能否在包含丰富多样机器人任务的数据上，训练一个能力出众的单一大型多任务骨干模型？这样的模型是否同样享有在其他领域中观察到的优势，展现出对新任务、新环境和新物体的零样本泛化能力？

blocks.en: Building such models in robotics is not easy. Although recent years have seen several large multitask robot policies proposed in the literature (Reed et al., 2022; Jang et al., 2021), such models often have limited breadth of real-world tasks, as with Gato (Reed et al., 2022), or focus on training tasks rather than generalization to new tasks, as with recent instruction following methods (Shridhar et al., 2021; 2022), or attain comparatively lower performance on new tasks (Jang et al., 2021).
blocks.zh: 在机器人领域构建此类模型绝非易事。尽管近年来文献中提出了若干大型多任务机器人策略（Reed et al., 2022; Jang et al., 2021），但这些模型在现实世界任务上的广度往往十分有限（如 Gato (Reed et al., 2022)），或者侧重于训练任务本身而非向新任务的泛化（如近期的指令遵循方法 (Shridhar et al., 2021; 2022)），抑或在新任务上取得相对较低的性能（Jang et al., 2021）。

(a) RT-1 takes images and natural language instructions and outputs discretized base and arm actions. Despite its size (35M parameters), it does this at 3 Hz, due to its efficient yet high-capacity architecture: a FiLM (Perez et al., 2018) conditioned EfficientNet (Tan & Le, 2019), a TokenLearner (Ryoo et al., 2021), and a Transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017).

blocks.en: The two main challenges lie in assembling the right dataset and designing the right model. While data collection and curation is often the “unsung hero” of many large-scale machine learning projects (Radford et al., 2021; Ramesh et al., 2021), this is especially true in robotics, where datasets are often robot-specific and gathered manually (Dasari et al., 2019; Ebert et al., 2021). As we will show in our evaluations, good generalization requires datasets that combine both scale and breadth, covering a variety of tasks and settings. At the same time, the tasks in the dataset should be sufficiently well-connected to enable generalization, such that the model can discover the patterns between structural similar tasks and perform new tasks that combine those patterns in novel ways. We utilize a dataset that we gathered over the course of 17 months with a fleet of 13 robots, containing ∼ 130k episodes and over 700 tasks, and we ablate various aspects of this dataset in our evaluation.
blocks.zh: 两大主要挑战在于构建合适的数据集以及设计合适的模型。尽管数据收集与整理往往是许多大规模机器学习项目中的“无名英雄”（Radford et al., 2021; Ramesh et al., 2021），但在机器人领域尤其如此，因为这里的数据集通常针对特定机器人且依赖人工采集（Dasari et al., 2019; Ebert et al., 2021）。正如我们将在评估中所证明的，良好的泛化能力需要兼具规模与广度的数据集，覆盖多样的任务与环境设置。与此同时，数据集中的各项任务应具有足够紧密的内在关联以支持泛化，使模型能够发现结构相似任务之间的规律，并以新颖的方式组合这些规律来执行新任务。我们利用了由 13 台机器人组成的机队历时 17 个月收集的数据集，其中包含约 13 万个（∼ 130k）episode 以及超过 700 项任务，并且我们在评估中对该数据集的各个方面进行了消融实验。

blocks.en: The second challenge lies in the design of the model itself. Effective robotic multi-task learning requires a high capacity model, and Transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017) models excel in this regard, particularly when it is necessary to learn many tasks conditioned, as in our case, on language instructions. However, robotic controllers must also be efficient enough to run in real time, which presents a major challenge for Transformers in particular. We propose a novel architecture that we call RT-1 (Robotics Transformer 1), which by encoding high-dimensional inputs and outputs, including camera images, instructions and motor commands into compact token representations to be used by the Transformer, allows for efficient inference at runtime to make real-time control feasible.
blocks.zh: 第二个挑战在于模型本身的设计。有效的机器人多任务学习需要高容量模型，而 Transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017) 模型在这方面表现卓越，特别是像我们这样需要以语言指令为条件来学习多项任务时更是如此。然而，机器人控制器还必须具备足够的效率以支持实时运行，这给 Transformer 带来了尤为重大的挑战。我们提出了一种名为 RT-1（Robotics Transformer 1）的新型架构，通过将高维输入与输出（包括相机图像、指令和电机控制命令）编码为供 Transformer 使用的紧凑 token 表示，实现了运行时的快速推理，使实时控制成为可能。

blocks.en: Our contribution is the RT-1 model and experiments with this model on a large and broad dataset of real-world robotic tasks. Our experiments not only demonstrate that RT-1 can exhibit significantly improved generalization and robustness compared to prior techniques, but also evaluate and ablate many design choices in both the model and in the composition of the training set. Our results show that RT-1 can perform over 700 training instructions at 97% success rate, and can generalize to new tasks, distractors, and backgrounds 25%, 36% and 18% better than the next best baseline, respectively. This level of performance allows us to execute very long-horizon tasks in the SayCan (Ahn et al., 2022) framework, with as many as 50 stages. We further show that RT-1 can incorporate data from simulation or even other robot types, retaining performance on the original tasks and improving generalization to new scenarios. A short overview of RT-1 capabilities is presented in Fig. 1b2 .
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献在于提出了 RT-1 模型，并在真实世界机器人任务的大规模、宽泛数据集上对该模型进行了实验。我们的实验不仅证明了 RT-1 相比以往技术能展现出显著提升的泛化能力与鲁棒性，还对模型及训练集构成中的诸多设计选择进行了评估与消融分析。我们的结果表明，RT-1 能够以 97% 的成功率执行 700 多条训练指令，并且在向新任务、干扰项和背景泛化时，性能分别比次优基线高出 25%、36% 和 18%。这种性能水平使我们能够在 SayCan (Ahn et al., 2022) 框架中执行多达 50 个阶段的超长视距任务。我们进一步证明，RT-1 能够融合来自仿真甚至其他机器人类型的数据，在保持原始任务性能的同时提升向新场景的泛化能力。图 1b2 对 RT-1 的能力进行了简短概述。

blocks.en: 2 RELATED WORK
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: A number of recent works have proposed Transformer-based policies for robotic control. As in RT-1, several works use language commands processed with Transformers as a robust framework for specifying and generalizing to new tasks (Zhang & Chai, 2021; Pashevich et al., 2021; Silva et al., 2021; Jang et al., 2021; Ahn et al., 2022; Nair et al., 2022). Our work takes the application of Transformers a step further and treats the mapping of language and vision observations to robot actions as a sequence modelling problem, using a Transformer to learn this mapping. This idea is directly inspired by successes in game-playing (Chen et al., 2021; Lee et al., 2022a) as well as simulated robot navigation (Fang et al., 2019), locomotion (Janner et al., 2021; Gupta et al., 2022), and manipulation (Jiang et al., 2022) environments. We note that several of these works go beyond only text conditioning and use Transformers to also generalize across robot morphologies (e.g., Gupta et al. (2022)) and other modalities for task specifications (e.g., Jang et al. (2021); Jiang et al. (2022)). These extensions are promising future directions for RT-1.
blocks.zh: 近期许多工作提出了用于机器人控制的基于 Transformer 的策略。与 RT-1 类似，一些工作使用由 Transformer 处理的语言指令作为指定任务并向新任务泛化的鲁棒框架（Zhang & Chai, 2021; Pashevich et al., 2021; Silva et al., 2021; Jang et al., 2021; Ahn et al., 2022; Nair et al., 2022）。我们的工作将 Transformer 的应用更推进一步，把语言和视觉观测到机器人动作的映射视为序列建模问题，并使用 Transformer 来学习这一映射。该构想直接受到游戏领域（Chen et al., 2021; Lee et al., 2022a）以及仿真机器人导航（Fang et al., 2019）、运动（locomotion）（Janner et al., 2021; Gupta et al., 2022）和操作（Jiang et al., 2022）环境中成功经验的启发。我们注意到，其中有若干工作不仅局限于文本条件化，还使用 Transformer 实现跨机器人形态（例如 Gupta et al. (2022)）以及其他任务指定模态（例如 Jang et al. (2021); Jiang et al. (2022)）的泛化。这些扩展方向对 RT-1 而言都是极具前景的未来研究方向。

blocks.en: Beyond Transformer-based policies, the focus of our work is on generalizable and robust real-world robotic manipulation at scale. Existing works on real-world Transformer-based robotic manipulation focus on efficiently learning tasks from a set of demonstrations per task (Shridhar et al., 2022). Behavior Transformer (Shafiullah et al., 2022) and Gato (Reed et al., 2022) advocate for training a single model on large-scale robotic and non-robotic datasets. However, these works are limited in their real-world robotic tasks; e.g., Gato learns effectively a single task (colored block stacking) without evaluating generalization to new tasks or a variety of real-world settings. On the technical side, our work examines how Transformer-based policies can be built so as to combine high capacity and generalization with the computational efficiency necessary for real-time control.
blocks.zh: 除基于 Transformer 的策略外，我们的工作重点在于规模化、具备泛化能力且鲁棒的现实世界机器人操作。现有的关于现实世界中基于 Transformer 的机器人操作的研究，主要聚焦于如何从每个任务的一组演示中高效学习任务（Shridhar et al., 2022）。Behavior Transformer（Shafiullah et al., 2022）与 Gato（Reed et al., 2022）提倡在大规模机器人及非机器人数据集上训练单一模型。然而，这些工作在现实世界机器人任务方面存在局限性；例如，Gato 实质上仅学习了单一任务（彩色积木堆叠），并未评估向新任务或多样化现实世界环境的泛化能力。在技术层面，我们的工作探讨了如何构建基于 Transformer 的策略，以将高容量和泛化能力与实时控制所需的计算效率相结合。

blocks.en: While the use of high-capacity Transformer models to learn robotic control policies is a fairly recent innovation, robotics has a long history of multi-task and language-conditioned learning, and RT-1 builds on these foundations. A significant body of work deals with learning policies and predictive models for robotic grasping (Saxena et al., 2006; Lenz et al., 2015; Pinto & Gupta, 2016; Gupta et al., 2018; Viereck et al., 2017), with the aim of generalizing to new objects. Prior works have sought to address robotic language understanding through pipelined approaches that combine language parsing, vision, and robotic control (MacMahon et al., 2006; Kollar et al., 2010; Tellex et al., 2011) and with end-to-end approaches (Mei et al., 2016; Stepputtis et al., 2020; Lynch & Sermanet, 2020; Ahn et al., 2022). Multi-task robotic learning has also been approached from the perspective of learning to reach goals (Chung et al., 2015; Raffin et al., 2019; Jurgenson et al., 2020; Huang et al., 2020), as well as learning policies that can perform tasks in a discrete set or some other parameterized form (Deisenroth et al., 2014; Devin et al., 2017; Fox et al., 2019; Kalashnikov et al., 2021a). A number of prior works in robotics have also focused on collecting datasets containing demonstrations or trials that illustrate a variety of different tasks (Sharma et al., 2018; Dasari et al., 2019; Yu et al., 2020; Singh et al., 2020; James et al., 2020). Our work adds further evidence in support of the power of multi-task, language-conditioned robotic learning, presenting experimental results at a larger scale and with a greater variety of behaviors, objects, and scenes and proposing new architectures and design choices that enable robotic learning at a significantly larger scale.
blocks.zh: 尽管使用高容量 Transformer 模型来学习机器人控制策略是一项相当新近的创新，但机器人在多任务和语言条件化学习方面有着悠久的历史，而 RT-1 正是建立在这些基础之上。大量研究探讨了用于机器人抓取的策略与预测模型学习（Saxena et al., 2006; Lenz et al., 2015; Pinto & Gupta, 2016; Gupta et al., 2018; Viereck et al., 2017），旨在泛化至新物体。先前的研究试图通过将语言解析、视觉和机器人控制相结合的流水线式方法（MacMahon et al., 2006; Kollar et al., 2010; Tellex et al., 2011）以及端到端方法（Mei et al., 2016; Stepputtis et al., 2020; Lynch & Sermanet, 2020; Ahn et al., 2022）来解决机器人语言理解问题。多任务机器人学习还曾从学习达成目标（learning to reach goals）的角度（Chung et al., 2015; Raffin et al., 2019; Jurgenson et al., 2020; Huang et al., 2020），以及学习能够在离散集合或某种其他参数化形式下执行任务的策略（Deisenroth et al., 2014; Devin et al., 2017; Fox et al., 2019; Kalashnikov et al., 2021a）来进行研究。此前机器人领域的诸多工作还致力于收集包含展示多种不同任务的演示或试验的数据集（Sharma et al., 2018; Dasari et al., 2019; Yu et al., 2020; Singh et al., 2020; James et al., 2020）。我们的工作为多任务、语言条件化机器人学习的效能提供了进一步的证据支持，展示了在更大规模、具备更多样行为、物体与场景下的实验结果，并提出了能够实现显著更大规模机器人学习的新架构与设计方案。

blocks.en: 3 PRELIMINARIES
blocks.zh: 3 预备知识

blocks.en: Robot learning. We aim to learn robot policies to solve language-conditioned tasks from vision. Formally, we consider a sequential decision-making environment. At timestep t = 0, the policy π is presented with a language instruction i and an initial image observation x 0. The policy produces an action distribution π ( · | i, x 0) from which an action a 0 is sampled and applied to the robot. This process continues, with the policy iteratively producing actions at by sampling from a learned distribution π ( · | i, {xj}t j =0) and applying those actions to the robot.The interaction ends when a termination condition is achieved. The full interaction i, { ( xj, aj ) }T j =0from from the starting step t = 0 to terminating step T is referred to as an episode . At the end of an episode, the agent will be given a binary reward r ∈{ 0 , 1 } indicating whether the robot performed the instruction i . The goal is to learn a policy π that maximizes the average reward, in expectation over a distribution of instructions, starting states x 0, and transition dynamics.
blocks.zh: 机器人学习。我们的目标是从视觉中学习机器人策略以解决语言条件化的任务。形式上，我们考虑一个序贯决策环境。在时间步 t = 0 时，策略 π 接收一条语言指令 i 和初始图像观测 x 0。策略生成动作分布 π ( · | i, x 0)，从中采样动作 a 0 并作用于机器人。这一过程持续进行，策略通过从学得的分布 π ( · | i, {xj}t j =0) 中采样来迭代生成动作 at，并将这些动作作用于机器人。当达到终止条件时交互结束。从起始步 t = 0 到终止步 T 的完整交互过程 i, { ( xj, aj ) }T j =0 被称为一个 episode。在一个 episode 结束时，智能体将获得一个二元奖励 r ∈{ 0 , 1 }，用以指示机器人是否完成了指令 i。目标是学习一个策略 π，以最大化在指令分布、初始状态 x 0 以及状态转移动态分布期望下的平均奖励。

blocks.en: Transformers. RT-1 uses a Transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017) to parameterize the policy π . Generally speaking, a Transformer is a sequence model mapping an input sequence {ξh}H h =0to an output sequence {yk}K k =0using combinations of self-attention layers and fully-connected neural networks. While Transformers were originally designed for text sequences, where each input ξj and output yk represents a text token, they have been extended to images (Parmar et al., 2018) as well as other modalities (Lee et al., 2022a; Reed et al., 2022). As detailed in the next section, we parameterize π by first mapping inputs i, {xj}t j =0toasequence{ξh} hH =0andactionoutputsattoasequence {yk}K k =0before using a Transformer to learn the mapping{ξh}H h =0→{yk}K k =0.
blocks.zh: Transformer。RT-1 使用 Transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017) 来对策略 π 进行参数化。通常而言，Transformer 是一种利用自注意力层与全连接神经网络组合，将输入序列 {ξh}H h =0 映射到输出序列 {yk}K k =0 的序列模型。虽然 Transformer 最初是针对文本序列设计的（其中每个输入 ξj 和输出 yk 代表一个文本 token），但它们已被扩展应用于图像 (Parmar et al., 2018) 以及其他模态 (Lee et al., 2022a; Reed et al., 2022)。如下节所详述，我们对 π 进行参数化时，首先将输入 i, {xj}t j =0 映射为序列 {ξh} hH =0，并将动作输出 at 映射为序列 {yk}K k =0，然后使用 Transformer 学习映射关系 {ξh}H h =0→{yk}K k =0。

blocks.en: Imitation learning. Imitation learning methods train the policy π on a dataset D of demonstrations (Pomerleau, 1988; Zhang et al., 2018; Jang et al., 2021). Specifically, we assume access to a dataset D = { ( i(n) , { ( x( tn) , a( tn) ) }tT =0(n))}N n =0of episodes, all of which are successful (i.e., have a final reward of 1). We learn π using behavioral cloning (Pomerleau, 1988), which optimizes π by minimizing the negative log-likelihood of actions at given the images and language instructions.
blocks.zh: 模仿学习。模仿学习方法在包含演示的数据集 D 上训练策略 π (Pomerleau, 1988; Zhang et al., 2018; Jang et al., 2021)。具体而言，我们假设可以访问一个由 episode 组成的数据集 D = { ( i(n) , { ( x( tn) , a( tn) ) }tT =0(n))}N n =0，其中所有 episode 均是成功的（即最终奖励为 1）。我们使用行为克隆 (Pomerleau, 1988) 来学习 π，其通过在给定图像和语言指令的条件下最小化动作 at 的负对数似然来优化 π。

blocks.en: 4 SYSTEM OVERVIEW
blocks.zh: 4 系统概览

blocks.en: The goal of this work is to build and demonstrate a general robot learning system that can absorb large amounts of data and generalize effectively. We use mobile manipulators from Everyday Robots3 , which have a 7 degree-of-freedom arm, a two-fingered gripper, and a mobile base (see Fig. 2 (d)). To collect data and evaluate our method, we use three kitchen-based environments: two real office kitchens and a training environment modelled off these real kitchens. The training environment, shown in Fig. 2 (a), consists of partial counters and is constructed for large scale data collection. The two real environments, shown in Fig. 2 (b, c), have similar counter tops to the training environment, but vary in lighting, background, and full kitchen geometry (e.g., there may be a cabinet instead of a drawer or a sink may be visible). We evaluate the performance of our policies across these different environments, measuring the policy’s performance and ability to generalize.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的目标是构建并展示一个能够吸收海量数据并实现有效泛化的通用机器人学习系统。我们使用来自 Everyday Robots3 的移动操作机，该机器配备一个 7 自由度机械臂、一个双指夹爪以及一个移动底座（见 Fig. 2 (d)）。为了采集数据并评估我们的方法，我们使用了三个厨房环境：两个真实的办公室厨房，以及一个参照这些真实厨房搭建的训练环境。如 Fig. 2 (a) 所示的训练环境由局部操作台组成，专为大规模数据采集而构建。如 Fig. 2 (b, c) 所示的两个真实环境拥有与训练环境相似的操作台面，但在光照、背景以及整个厨房的几何结构上各不相同（例如，可能出现橱柜而非抽屉，或者可以看到水槽）。我们在这些不同环境中评估我们策略的性能，以衡量该策略的执行效果与泛化能力。

blocks.en: Our training data consists of human-provided demonstrations, and we annotate each episode with a textual description of the instruction that the robot just performed. The instructions usually contain a verb and one or more nouns describing the target objects. To group these instructions together, we split them into a number of skills (e.g., verbs such as “pick”, “open” or “place upright”) and objects (e.g., nouns such as “coke can”, “apple”, or “drawer”). We describe the details of our data collection strategy at scale in Sec. 5.2. Our largest dataset contains over 130k individual demonstrations constituting over 700 distinct task instructions using a large variety of objects (see Fig. 2 (f)). We describe the details of the data collected in Sec. 5.2.
blocks.zh: 我们的训练数据由人类提供的示教组成，我们为每个 episode 标注机器人刚刚执行的指令的文本描述。这些指令通常包含一个动词以及一个或多个描述目标物体的名词。为了对这些指令进行归类，我们将其划分为若干技能（例如“pick”、“open”或“place upright”等动词）和物体（例如“coke can”、“apple”或“drawer”等名词）。我们在 Sec. 5.2 中详细介绍了我们的大规模数据采集策略。我们最大的数据集包含超过 130k 条独立示教，涵盖了使用多种多样物体的 700 多条不同任务指令（见 Fig. 2 (f)）。我们在 Sec. 5.2 中对采集到的数据进行了详细描述。

blocks.en: One of the main contributions of our system is the network architecture, Robotics Transformer 1 (RT-1), an efficient model that can absorb large amounts of data, effectively generalize, and output actions at real-time rates for practical robotic control. RT-1 takes a short sequence of images and a natural language instruction as input and outputs an action for the robot at each time step. To this end, the architecture (shown in Figure 1a) leverages several elements: first the images and text are processed via an ImageNet pretrained convolutional network (Tan & Le, 2019) conditioned on a pretrained embedding of the instruction via FiLM (Perez et al., 2018), followed by a Token Learner (Ryoo et al., 2021) to compute a compact set of tokens, and finally a Transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017) to attend over these tokens and produce discretized action tokens. The actions consist of seven dimensions for the arm movement (x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw, opening of the gripper), three dimensions for base movement (x, y, yaw) and a discrete dimension to switch between three modes: controlling the arm, the base, or terminating the episode. RT-1 performs closed-loop control and commands actions at 3 Hz until it either yields a “terminate” action or hits a pre-set time step limit.
blocks.zh: 我们系统的一大核心贡献在于网络架构 Robotics Transformer 1 (RT-1)，这是一个高效模型，能够吸收海量数据、有效泛化，并以适用于实际机器人控制的实时速率输出动作。RT-1 以简短的历史图像序列和自然语言指令作为输入，并在每个时间步输出机器人的动作。为此，该架构（如图 Figure 1a 所示）集成了几个关键要素：首先，图像和文本通过在 ImageNet 上预训练的卷积网络（Tan & Le, 2019）进行处理，其中利用 FiLM（Perez et al., 2018）基于预训练的指令嵌入对网络进行条件化；随后利用 TokenLearner（Ryoo et al., 2021）计算一组紧凑的 token；最后利用 Transformer（Vaswani et al., 2017）对这些 token 进行注意力计算并生成离散化的动作 token。动作包含：机械臂运动的 7 个维度（x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw, 夹爪开合度）、底座移动的 3 个维度（x, y, yaw），以及用于在三种模式之间切换的 1 个离散维度：控制机械臂、控制底座或终止当前 episode。RT-1 执行闭环控制，并以 3 Hz 的频率下发动作指令，直到生成“terminate”（终止）动作或达到预设的时间步上限。

blocks.en: 5.1 MODEL
blocks.zh: 5.1 模型

blocks.en: Our model is built on a Transformer architecture (Vaswani et al., 2017) and takes a history of images and task description as input and directly outputs tokenized actions, as shown in Fig. 1a and in detail in Fig. 3. In the following we describe the components of the model, following the top-to-bottom order in Fig. 3. More detail on model selection at scale are provided in Appendix C.3.
blocks.zh: 我们的模型建立在 Transformer 架构（Vaswani et al., 2017）之上，以历史图像序列和任务描述作为输入，并直接输出 token 化的动作，如图 Fig. 1a 所示，详见 Fig. 3。接下来，我们按照 Fig. 3 中自顶向下的顺序介绍模型的各个组件。关于大规模模型选择的更多细节见 Appendix C.3。

blocks.en: Instruction and image tokenization. The RT-1 architecture relies on a data-efficient and compact tokenization of images and language instruction. RT-1 tokenizes a history of 6 images by passing images through an ImageNet pretrained EfficientNet-B3 (Tan & Le, 2019) model, which takes 6 images of resolution 300 × 300 as input and outputs a spatial feature map of shape 9 × 9 × 512 from the final convolutional layer. Unlike Reed et al. (2022), we do not patchify the images into visual tokens prior to feeding them to our Transformer backbone. We instead flatten the output feature map from the EfficientNet into 81 visual tokens which are passed on to the later layers of the network.
blocks.zh: 指令与图像的 token 化。RT-1 架构依赖于对图像和语言指令进行兼具数据高效性与紧凑性的 token 化。RT-1 通过将历史 6 帧图像输入至在 ImageNet 上预训练的 EfficientNet-B3（Tan & Le, 2019）模型来对图像进行 token 化；该模型以 6 张分辨率为 300 × 300 的图像作为输入，并从最后一个卷积层输出形状为 9 × 9 × 512 的空间特征图。与 Reed et al. (2022) 不同，我们在将图像输入 Transformer 主干网络之前，并未将其切分为 patch 形式的视觉 token。相反，我们将 EfficientNet 输出的特征图展平为 81 个视觉 token，并传递至网络的后续各层。

blocks.en: To include the language instruction, we condition the image tokenizer on the natural language instruction in the form of a pretrained language embedding, allowing extraction of task-relevant image features early on and improving performance of RT-1. The instruction is first embedded via Universal Sentence Encoder (Cer et al., 2018). This embedding is then used as input to identity-initialized FiLM layers (Perez et al., 2018) added to the pretrained EfficientNet to condition the image encoder. Normally, inserting a FiLM layer into the interior of a pretrained network would disrupt the intermediate activations and negate the benefit of using pretrained weights. To overcome this, we initialize the weights of the dense layers ( fc and hC ) which produce the FiLM affine transformation to zero, allowing the FiLM layer to initially act as an identity and preserve the function of the pretrained weights. We find that identity-initialized FiLM also produces better results when training with an EfficientNet initialized from scratch, without ImageNet pretraining, but it does not surpass the initialization described above. The architecture of the image tokenizer is presented in Fig. 3.
blocks.zh: 为了融入语言指令，我们以预训练语言嵌入的形式，基于自然语言指令对图像 tokenizer 进行条件化，从而能够在早期提取与任务相关的图像特征并提升 RT-1 的性能。指令首先通过 Universal Sentence Encoder（Cer et al., 2018）进行嵌入。该嵌入随后作为输入，送入添加到预训练 EfficientNet 中的恒等初始化 FiLM 层（Perez et al., 2018），以对图像编码器进行条件化调节。通常情况下，在预训练网络内部插入 FiLM 层会扰乱中间激活值，并抵消使用预训练权重带来的收益。为了克服这一问题，我们将用于生成 FiLM 仿射变换的稠密层（fc 与 hC）的权重初始化为零，使 FiLM 层在初始状态下表现为恒等映射，从而保留预训练权重的功能。我们发现，在没有 ImageNet 预训练、从零初始化 EfficientNet 进行训练时，恒等初始化的 FiLM 也能带来更好的效果，但其表现仍未超过上述预训练初始化方案。图像 tokenizer 的架构如图 Fig. 3 所示。

blocks.en: RT-1’s image and instruction tokenization via FiLM EfficientNet-B3 is a total of 16M parameters, with 26 layers of MBConv blocks and FiLM layers, which output 81 vision-language tokens.
blocks.zh: RT-1 基于 FiLM EfficientNet-B3 的图像与指令 token 化模块总共包含 16M 参数，由 26 层 MBConv 块和 FiLM 层组成，输出 81 个视觉-语言 token。

blocks.en: TokenLearner. To further compress the number of tokens that RT-1 needs to attend over and thus speed up inference, RT-1 uses TokenLearner (Ryoo et al., 2021). TokenLearner is an elementwise attention module that learns to map a large number of tokens into a much smaller number of tokens. This allows us to soft-select image tokens based on their information, passing only the important token combinations to the subsequent Transformer layers. The inclusion of TokenLearner subsamples the 81 visual tokens that come out of the pre-trained FiLM-EfficientNet layers to just 8 final tokens that are then passed on to our Transformer layers.
blocks.zh: TokenLearner。为了进一步压缩 RT-1 需要进行注意力计算的 token 数量，从而加快推理速度，RT-1 采用了 TokenLearner（Ryoo et al., 2021）。TokenLearner 是一个逐元素注意力模块，可学习将大量 token 映射为数量少得多的 token。这使我们能够根据图像 token 的信息进行软选择，仅将重要的 token 组合传递给后续的 Transformer 层。引入 TokenLearner 后，从预训练 FiLM-EfficientNet 层输出的 81 个视觉 token 被下采样至仅 8 个最终 token，随后传递至我们的 Transformer 层。

The resulting vision-language tokens are reduced by the TokenLearner and fed into a decoder-only Transformer, which outputs tokenized actions.

blocks.en: Transformer. These 8 tokens per-image are then concatenated with the other images in the history, forming 48 total tokens (with added position encoding) to be fed into the Transformer backbone of RT-1. The Transformer is a decoder-only sequence model with 8 self-attention layers and 19M total parameters that outputs action tokens.
blocks.zh: Transformer。每张图像生成的这 8 个 token 随后与历史序列中其他图像的 token 进行拼接，总共形成 48 个 token（加上位置编码），并送入 RT-1 的 Transformer 主干网络。该 Transformer 是一个仅解码器的序列模型，包含 8 个自注意力层，共有 19M 参数，用于输出动作 token。

blocks.en: Action tokenization. To tokenize actions, each action dimension in RT-1 is discretized into 256 bins. As mentioned previously, the action dimensions we consider include seven variables for the arm movement ( x , y , z , roll, pitch, yaw, ~~o~~ pening of the gri pp er), three variables for base movement ( x , y , yaw) and a discrete variable to switch between three ~~m~~ odes: controlling arm, base or terminating the episode. For each variable, we map the target to one of the 256 bins, where the bins are uniformly distributed within the bounds of each variable.
blocks.zh: 动作 token 化。为了对动作进行 token 化，RT-1 中的每个动作维度都被离散化为 256 个 bin。如前所述，我们考虑的动作维度包括机械臂运动的 7 个变量（x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw, 夹爪开合度）、底座移动的 3 个变量（x, y, yaw），以及用于在三种模式之间切换的 1 个离散变量：控制机械臂、控制底座或终止当前 episode。对于每个变量，我们将目标值映射到 256 个 bin 之一，这些 bin 均匀分布在每个变量的取值边界范围内。

blocks.en: Loss. We use a standard categorical cross-entropy entropy objective and causal masking that was utilized in prior Transformer-based controllers (Reed et al., 2022; Lee et al., 2022a).
blocks.zh: 损失函数。我们采用标准的分类别交叉熵目标和因果掩码，这在此前基于 Transformer 的控制器中已被使用（Reed et al., 2022; Lee et al., 2022a）。

blocks.en: Inference speed. In contrast to many applications of large models, such as natural language or image generation, one of the unique requirements for a model that needs to run on real robots in real time is fast and consistent inference speed. Given the human speeds of executing the instructions
blocks.zh: 推理速度。与大模型的许多应用（如自然语言或图像生成）相比，需要在真实机器人上实时运行的模型有一项独特要求，即快速且一致的推理速度。鉴于人类执行本工作所涉及指令的速度

blocks.en: considered in this work (which we measured to be in the 2 − 4 secs range), we want the model to be not significantly slower than that. Based on our experiments this requirement corresponds to at least 3Hz control frequency and the resulting inference time budget for the model, given other latencies in the system, to be less than 100ms.
blocks.zh: （我们测得该速度在 2 − 4 秒范围内），我们希望模型不要明显慢于该速度。根据我们的实验，这一要求对应于至少 3 Hz 的控制频率；考虑到系统中的其他延迟，由此留给模型的推理时间预算需小于 100 ms。

blocks.en: This requirement limits the size of the model that we can use. We further explore the impact of model size on inference speed in the experiments. We employ two techniques to speed up inference: (i) reduce the number of tokens generated by a pre-trained EfficientNet model by using TokenLearner (Ryoo et al., 2021), (ii) compute these tokens only once and reuse them for the following windows that overlap for the future inferences. Both of these allow us to speed up the model inference by 2 . 4 and 1 . 7 times, respectively. Additional details on model inference are in Appendix C.1.
blocks.zh: 这一要求限制了我们所能使用的模型规模。我们在实验中进一步探讨了模型规模对推理速度的影响。我们采用了两项技术来加快推理速度：(i) 利用 TokenLearner（Ryoo et al., 2021）减少预训练 EfficientNet 模型生成的 token 数量；(ii) 仅计算这些 token 一次，并在后续重叠窗口的未来推理中予以复用。这两项技术分别使模型推理加速了 2.4 倍和 1.7 倍。有关模型推理的更多细节见 Appendix C.1。

blocks.en: Our goal is to build a system that exhibits high performance, generalization to new tasks, and robustness to distractors and backgrounds. We therefore aim to collect a large, diverse dataset of robot trajectories that includes multiple tasks, objects and environments. Our primary dataset consists of ∼ 130k robot demonstrations, collected with a fleet of 13 robots over the course of 17 months. We conducted this large-scale data collection in a series of office kitchen segments, which we refer to as robot classrooms , shown in Fig. 2. More details on data collection are in Appendix C.2.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是构建一个展现出高性能、对新任务具有泛化能力，且对干扰物和背景具有鲁棒性的系统。因此，我们旨在采集一个涵盖多种任务、物体和环境的大规模、多样化机器人轨迹数据集。我们的主要数据集包含约 130k 条机器人示教，是由 13 台机器人组成的机队历时 17 个月采集而成的。我们在如图 Fig. 2 所示的一系列办公厨房隔间（我们称之为机器人教室）中进行了这一大规模数据采集。关于数据采集的更多细节见 Appendix C.2。

blocks.en: Skills and instructions. While the definition of a task remains inconsistent in the literature, in this work we count the number of language instructions that the system can perform, where an instruction corresponds to a verb surrounded by one or multiple nouns, such as “ place water bottle upright ”, “ move the coke can to the green chip bag” or “ open the drawer”. RT-1 is able to perform over 700 language instructions in multiple realistic office kitchen environments that we evaluate and describe in detail in the experiments. In order to group the evaluations and draw conclusions on the performance of the system, we group the instructions by the verbs used in them, which we refer to as skills . A more detailed list of instructions is shown in Table 1, with examples and the number of instructions per skill.
blocks.zh: 技能与指令。尽管文献中对任务的定义仍不尽一致，但在本工作中，我们以系统能够执行的语言指令数量来进行统计，其中一条指令对应一个由一个或多个名词修饰的动词，例如“place water bottle upright”（将水瓶直立放置）、“move the coke can to the green chip bag”（将可乐罐移至绿色薯片袋旁）或“open the drawer”（打开抽屉）。RT-1 能够在多种真实的办公室厨房环境中执行 700 多条语言指令，我们在实验中对其进行了评估并作了详细描述。为了对评估进行分组并得出关于系统性能的结论，我们根据指令中使用的动词对指令进行分组，并将其称为技能。更详细的指令列表如 Table 1 所示，其中包含示例以及每种技能对应的指令数量。

blocks.en: The current set of skills includes picking, placing, opening and closing drawers, getting items in and out drawers, placing elongated items up-right, knocking them over, pulling napkins and opening jars. The skills were chosen to demonstrate multiple behaviors with many objects (seen in Fig. 2(e)) to test aspects of RT-1 such as generalization to new instructions and ability to perform many tasks. We then greatly expanded the object diversity for the “pick” skill to make sure that the skills generalize to varied objects (see the expanded set of objects in Fig. 2(f)). The skills were further expanded while we conducted the ablations to include instructions added in the last row of Table 1, which were used for the experiments described in Sec. 6.4 and 6.3. These additional skills focused on realistic, long-horizon instructions in an office kitchen. The entire process of adding tasks and data is described in the Appendix C.4. Since we do not make any assumptions about particular skills when adding new instructions, the system is easily extendable, and we can continuously provide more diverse data to improve its capabilities.
blocks.zh: 目前的技能集合包括抓取、放置、开关抽屉、将物品放入/取出抽屉、将细长物品直立放置、将其推倒、抽取纸巾以及打开罐子。选取这些技能是为了针对众多物体展现出多种行为（见 Fig. 2(e)），以测试 RT-1 在对新指令的泛化能力以及执行多样任务能力等方面的表现。随后，我们极大地扩展了“抓取”（pick）技能的物体多样性，以确保技能能够泛化到不同的物体上（见 Fig. 2(f) 中的扩展物体集）。在进行消融实验期间，我们进一步扩展了技能集，加入了 Table 1 最后一行中增加的指令，这些指令用于 Sec. 6.4 和 6.3 中描述的实验。这些新增技能侧重于办公室厨房中真实的长时间跨度（long-horizon）指令。添加任务和数据的完整过程见 Appendix C.4。由于我们在添加新指令时未对特定技能做任何假设，因此该系统极易扩展，我们也可以持续提供更多样的数据来提升其能力。

blocks.en: 6 EXPERIMENTS
blocks.zh: 6 实验

blocks.en: Our experiments seek to answer the following questions:
blocks.zh: 我们的实验旨在回答以下问题：

blocks.en: 1. Can an RT-1 learn to perform a large number of instructions, as well as to generalize in zero shot to new tasks, objects and environments? (Section 6.2)
blocks.zh: 1. RT-1 能否学会执行大量指令，并以零样本方式泛化到新的任务、物体和环境？（Section 6.2）

blocks.en: 2. Can we push the resulting model even further by incorporating heterogeneous data sources, such as simulated data or data from different robots? (Section 6.3)
blocks.zh: 2. 我们能否通过整合异构数据源（例如仿真数据或来自不同机器人的数据），进一步提升所得模型的性能？（Section 6.3）

blocks.en: 3. How do various methods generalize to long-horizon robotic scenarios? (Section 6.4) 4. How do generalization metrics change with varying amounts of data quantity and data diversity? (Section 6.5)
blocks.zh: 3. 各种方法如何泛化到长时间跨度的机器人任务场景？（Section 6.4） 4. 泛化指标如何随着数据量与数据多样性的变化而改变？（Section 6.5）

blocks.en: 5. What are the important and practical decisions in the design of the model and how do they affect performance and generalization? (Appendix Section D.4)
blocks.zh: 5. 模型设计中有哪些重要且实用的决策，它们如何影响性能与泛化能力？（Appendix Section D.4）

blocks.en: Throughout this section we will compare to two baseline state of the art architectures, Gato (Reed et al., 2022) and BC-Z (Jang et al., 2021). Importantly both of these are trained on our data described in detail in Sec. 5.2 (which is an important part of our system) since the original models in these publications would not exhibit generalization properties required for our evaluation tasks. Gato is, similarly to RT-1, based on a Transformer architecture, but varies from RT-1 in multiple aspects. First, it computes image tokens without the notion of language and each image token embedding is computed separately for each image patch, as opposed to early language fusion and global image embedding in our model. Second, it does not use a pre-trained text embedding to encode the language string. It also does not include inference time considerations that are necessary for real robots as discussed in Sec. 5.1 such as TokenLearner and the removal of auto-regressive actions. In order to run Gato on real robots at a high enough frequency, we also limit the size of the model compared to the original publication, which was 1.2B parameters (resulting in on robot inference time of 1 . 9s), to be of similar size to RT-1 (37M parameters for Gato vs. 35M for RT-1). BC-Z is based on a ResNet architecture, and was used in SayCan (Ahn et al., 2022). BC-Z differs from RT-1 in that it is a feedforward model that does not use previous timesteps, and it uses continuous actions rather than discrete action tokens. In addition to the original BC-Z model size, we also compare our method to a larger version of BC-Z that has a similar number of parameters to RT-1 and refer to it as BC-Z XL. We study and analyze how each of these design decisions changes performance in Appendix Sections D.4 and D.5.
blocks.zh: 在整个本节中，我们将与两种代表现有最高水平的基线架构进行对比：Gato（Reed et al., 2022）和 BC-Z（Jang et al., 2021）。重要的是，这两者均在我们于 Sec. 5.2 中详细描述的数据集上进行了训练（这是我们系统的重要组成部分），因为这些文献中的原始模型无法展现出我们评估任务所要求的泛化特性。与 RT-1 类似，Gato 也是基于 Transformer 架构，但在多个方面与 RT-1 有所不同。首先，它在不结合语言概念的情况下计算图像 token，且每个图像 token 嵌入是针对各个图像 patch 分别独立计算的，而我们的模型则采用早期语言融合与全局图像嵌入。其次，它没有使用预训练的文本嵌入来编码语言字符串。此外，它也不包含 Sec. 5.1 中讨论的真实机器人所必需的推理时间优化考量，例如 TokenLearner 以及去除自回归动作生成。为了在真实机器人上以足够高的频率运行 Gato，相较于原论文中 1.2B 参数的模型规模（导致在机器人上的推理时间达到 1.9 秒），我们限制了其模型大小，使其与 RT-1 规模相当（Gato 为 37M 参数，RT-1 为 35M 参数）。BC-Z 基于 ResNet 架构，曾应用于 SayCan（Ahn et al., 2022）。BC-Z 与 RT-1 的不同之处在于它是一个不使用以往时间步信息的前馈模型，且使用连续动作而非离散动作 token。除了原始的 BC-Z 模型大小外，我们还将我们的方法与参数量同 RT-1 相近的更大版本 BC-Z 进行了对比，并将其称为 BC-Z XL。我们在 Appendix Sections D.4 和 D.5 中深入研究并分析了这些设计决策各自对性能产生的影响。

blocks.en: We evaluate the success rate in experiments to measure performance on training instructions, generalization to unseen instructions, robustness to backgrounds and distractors, and performance in long-horizon scenarios, as detailed below. Throughout this section, we evaluate our approach and baselines with over 3000 real-world trials, making one of the largest scale evaluation of a robot learning system to-date.
blocks.zh: 我们在实验中通过评估成功率来衡量模型在训练指令上的性能、对未见指令的泛化能力、对背景和干扰物的鲁棒性，以及在长时域场景中的表现，具体细节如下所述。在本节中，我们通过 3000 多次真实世界试验对我们的方法及各基准进行了评估，这是迄今为止针对机器人学习系统开展的规模最大的评估之一。

blocks.en: 6.1 EXPERIMENTAL SETUP
blocks.zh: 6.1 实验设置

blocks.en: As mentioned in Section 4, we evaluate RT-1 with a set of mobile manipulators from Everyday Robots in three environments: two real office kitchens and a training environment modelled off these real kitchens. The training environment, shown in Fig. 2 (a), consists of partial counters while the two real environments, shown in Fig. 2 (b, c), have similar counter tops to the training environment, but vary in lighting, background, and full kitchen geometry (e.g., there may be a cabinet instead of a drawer or a sink may be visible). The policies are evaluated for performance on training tasks as well as generalization to new tasks, robustness to unseen environments, and performance when chained together for long-horizon tasks, as detailed below.
blocks.zh: 如第 4 节所述，我们在三种环境中使用来自 Everyday Robots 的一组移动操作机对 RT-1 进行评估：两个真实的办公室厨房，以及一个参照这些真实厨房搭建的训练环境。如图 2 (a) 所示的训练环境由局部操作台组成，而如图 2 (b, c) 所示的两个真实环境虽然拥有与训练环境相似的操作台台面，但在光照、背景以及完整的厨房几何结构上均有所不同（例如，原本放置抽屉的位置可能变成了橱柜，或者水槽处于可见范围内）。我们对这些策略在训练任务上的性能、对新任务的泛化能力、对未见环境的鲁棒性，以及串联执行长时域任务时的表现进行了评估，具体细节如下所述。

blocks.en: Seen task performance. To evaluate performance on seen instructions, we evaluate performance on instructions sampled from the training set. Note, however, that this evaluation still involves varying the placement of objects and other factors of the setup (e.g., time of day, robot position), requiring the skills to generalize to realistic variability in the environment. In all, we test over 200 tasks in this evaluation: 36 for picking objects, 35 for knocking objects, 35 for placing things upright, 48 for moving objects, 18 for opening and closing various drawers, and 36 for picking out of and placing objects into drawers.
blocks.zh: 已见任务表现。为了评估在已见指令上的表现，我们对从训练集中采样的指令进行了性能评估。然而需要说明的是，该评估仍然会改变物体的摆放位置以及设置中的其他因素（例如时间段、机器人位置），要求各项技能能够泛化到环境中的真实变化。在此项评估中，我们总共测试了 200 多项任务：36 项抓取物体、35 项击倒物体、35 项正立放置物体、48 项移动物体、18 项打开和关闭各类抽屉，以及 36 项从抽屉中取出物体和将物体放入抽屉。

blocks.en: Unseen tasks generalization. To evaluate generalization to unseen tasks, we test 21 novel, unseen instructions. These instructions are distributed across skills and objects. This ensures that at least
blocks.zh: 未见任务泛化。为了评估对未见任务的泛化能力，我们测试了 21 条全新的未见指令。这些指令分布在不同的技能和物体中。这确保了至少

blocks.en: some instances of each object and skill were present in the training set but they will be combined in novel ways. For example, if “pick up the apple” is held out, then there are other training instructions that include the apple. The list of all unseen instructions can be found in the Appendix D.1.
blocks.zh: 每种物体和技能的某些实例都在训练集中出现过，但它们会以全新的方式进行组合。例如，若将“拿起苹果”作为保留未见的测试项，则训练指令中还会包含其他涉及苹果的指令。所有未见指令的完整列表见附录 D.1。

blocks.en: Robustness. To evaluate robustness, we perform 30 real-world tasks for distractor robustness and 22 tasks for background robustness. The background robustness was tested by evaluating in new kitchens (which have different lighting and background visuals) and with different counter surfaces (e.g., a patterned table cloth). Example configurations of the robustness evaluation scenarios are depicted in Fig. 4.
blocks.zh: 鲁棒性。为了评估鲁棒性，我们执行了 30 项用于评估干扰物鲁棒性的真实世界任务，以及 22 项用于评估背景鲁棒性的任务。背景鲁棒性是通过在全新厨房（具有不同的光照条件与背景视觉外观）以及不同台面材质（例如带图案的桌布）中进行评估来测试的。鲁棒性评估场景的示例配置如图 4 所示。

blocks.en: Long-horizon scenarios. We also evaluate generalization to more realistic long-horizon scenarios, which each require executing a sequence of skills. The goal of this evaluation is to combine multiple generalization axes such as new tasks, objects, environments and test the overall generalization capabilities in realistic settings. These evaluations consist of 15 long-horizon instructions in two real kitchens, which require executing sequences of skills consisting of ∼ 10 distinct steps, with each step of roughly comparable scope as the training instructions. These steps are obtained automatically from higher level instructions, such as “how would you throw away all the items on the table?” by using the SayCan system (Ahn et al., 2022), as described in detail in Section 6.4 and Appendix D.3.
blocks.zh: 长时域场景。我们还评估了向更逼真的长时域场景的泛化能力，每个场景都需要执行一系列技能。该评估的目标是将多个泛化维度（例如新任务、新物体、新环境）结合起来，并在真实设置中测试整体泛化能力。这些评估包含在两个真实厨房中的 15 条长时域指令，需要执行由 ∼ 10 个独立步骤组成的技能序列，且每个步骤的作用范围与训练指令大致相当。这些步骤是利用 SayCan 系统（Ahn et al., 2022）从更高层级的指令（例如“你如何把桌上的所有物品扔掉？”）中自动获取的，详见第 6.4 节和附录 D.3。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Evaluation scenarios for distractors (first row), from left to right: easy (0-5 distractors), medium (9 distractors), hard (9 distractors and occluded object); background (second row), from left to right: original environment, patterned table cloth, new kitchen; and realistic scenarios in the real kitchen (third row), generalization levels from left to right: L 1, L 2 and L 3.
blocks.zh: 图 4：干扰物评估场景（第一行），从左至右依次为：简单（0-5 个干扰物）、中等（9 个干扰物）、困难（9 个干扰物且目标物体被遮挡）；背景评估场景（第二行），从左至右依次为：原始环境、带图案的桌布、新厨房；以及真实厨房中的逼真场景（第三行），泛化等级从左至右依次为：L 1、L 2 和 L 3。

blocks.en: - 6.2 CAN RT-1 LEARN TO PERFORM A LARGE NUMBER OF INSTRUCTIONS, AND TO GENERALIZE TO NEW TASKS, OBJECTS AND ENVIRONMENTS?
blocks.zh: - 6.2 RT-1 能否学会执行大量指令，并泛化到新的任务、物体和环境？

blocks.en: To answer our first question, we analyze the overall performance, generalization, and robustness capabilities of RT-1 compared to previously proposed models. Specifically, we compare to the model architectures used by Gato (Reed et al., 2022) and BC-Z (Jang et al., 2021), as well as a larger version of BC-Z, which we refer to as BC-Z XL. Note, however, that all models are trained on the same data as RT-1, and the evaluation only compares the model architectures, not the task sets, datasets, or overall robotic systems. The capabilities of RT-1 are determined to a large extent by the dataset and task set, which we believe improves significantly over prior works (e.g. BC-Z uses 100 tasks and the original Gato model trains a stacking task with various shapes), and thus this comparison should be viewed as rather favorable to the prior models, which also benefit from the large and diverse dataset and task set that we collected.
blocks.zh: 为了回答我们的第一个问题，我们将 RT-1 与之前提出的模型进行对比，分析其整体性能、泛化能力与鲁棒性。具体而言，我们对比了 Gato（Reed et al., 2022）和 BC-Z（Jang et al., 2021）所使用的模型架构，以及 BC-Z 的更大版本（我们称之为 BC-Z XL）。但需要注意的是，所有模型都是在与 RT-1 相同的数据上进行训练的，此次评估仅对比模型架构，而非任务集、数据集或整个机器人系统。RT-1 的能力在很大程度上取决于数据集和任务集，我们认为这比以往的工作有了显著提升（例如 BC-Z 仅使用 100 项任务，而最初的 Gato 模型仅训练包含各种形状的堆叠任务），因此这一对比应被视为对以往模型相当有利，因为它们同样受益于我们所收集的大规模且多样化的数据集和任务集。

blocks.en: The results are shown in Table 2. Across each category, we find that RT-1 outperforms the prior models significantly. On seen tasks, RT-1 is able to perform 97% of the more than 200 instruc-
blocks.zh: 结果如表 2 所示。在各个类别中，我们发现 RT-1 均显著优于先前的模型。在已见任务上，RT-1 能够成功执行 200 多条指令中的 97%——

blocks.en: |Model|Seen Tasks|Unseen Tasks|Distractors|Backgrounds| |---|---|---|---|---| |Gato (Reed et al., 2022)|65|52|43|35| |BC-Z (Jang et al., 2021)|72|19|47|41| |BC-Z XL|56|43|23|35| |RT-1 (ours)|97|76|83|59|
Table 2: Overall performance of RT-1 and baselines across seen tasks, generalization to unseen tasks, and robustness to distractors and backgrounds.
blocks.zh: 表 2：RT-1 与各基线在已见任务、对未见任务的泛化能力，以及对干扰物和背景的鲁棒性方面的整体性能表现。

blocks.en: tions successfully, which is 25% more than BC-Z and 32% more than Gato. On unseen tasks, RT-1 shows it is capable of generalizing to novel instructions, performing 76% of the never-before-seen instructions, 24% more than the next best baseline. While such generalization to novel instructions is made possible due to natural language conditioning of the policy, as the policy is able to understand new combinations of previously seen concepts, all of the baselines are also conditioned on natural language and in principle enjoy the same benefits. We further ablate different components of RT-1 in the next section to better understand what aspects of our method contribute the most to this difference. On distractors and backgrounds, we find that RT-1 is quite robust, successfully executing 83% of the distractor robustness tasks and 59% of the background robustness tasks (36% and 18% higher than the next best alternative, respectively). Overall, we find that RT-1 has high general performance, while exhibiting impressive degrees of generalization and robustness. We show example trajectories of the RT-1 agent including instructions that cover different skills, environments and objects in Fig. 5. We also present additional trajectory examples for different generalization tests in the Appendix, which include backgrounds (Fig. 10), and distractors (Fig. 12).
blocks.zh: ——这比 BC-Z 高出 25%，比 Gato 高出 32%。在未见任务上，RT-1 展现出泛化到新颖指令的能力，能够完成 76% 从未见过的指令，比次优基线高出 24%。尽管这种对新指令的泛化能力归功于策略以自然语言为条件（使策略能够理解先前见过的概念的新组合），但所有基线也均以自然语言为条件，原则上享有相同的优势。我们在下一节中进一步对 RT-1 的不同组件进行消融分析，以深入了解我们方法的哪些方面对这一差距贡献最大。在干扰物和背景方面，我们发现 RT-1 相当鲁棒，成功执行了 83% 的干扰物鲁棒性任务和 59% 的背景鲁棒性任务（分别比次优方案高出 36% 和 18%）。总体而言，我们发现 RT-1 具有优异的通用性能，同时表现出令人瞩目的泛化与鲁棒水平。我们在图 5 中展示了 RT-1 智能体的示例轨迹，包括涵盖不同技能、环境和物体的指令。我们还在附录中提供了针对不同泛化测试的额外轨迹示例，包括背景测试（图 10）和干扰物测试（图 12）。

blocks.en: Generalization to realistic instructions. Next, we test whether our method generalizes enough across all the different axes that we evaluated previously to be deployed in a real kitchen, which poses multiple distribution shifts all at once such as new tasks combinations, object distractors as well as a novel environment.
blocks.zh: 对现实指令的泛化。接下来，我们测试我们的方法在先前评估的各个不同维度上是否具备足够的泛化能力，从而能够部署在真实的厨房中；真实厨房会同时带来多重分布偏移，例如新的任务组合、物体干扰物以及全新的环境。

blocks.en: To evaluate our algorithm in realistic scenarios in a real kitchen, we construct task sequences to accomplish a number of realistic goals. The robot restocks several snacks in drawers, tidies up knocked over condiment bottles and closes drawers left open by humans, prepares a snack with an orange and a napkin and fetches lost sunglasses and an octopus toy from several places in the kitchen. The detailed instructions used in these scenarios are listed in the Appendix D.1. The office kitchen involves a dramatic shift from the training environment and we categorize tasks across these scenarios with varying levels of generalization: L 1 for generalization to the new counter-top layout and lighting conditions, L 2 for additionally generalization to unseen distractor objects, L 3 for additional generalization to drastically new task settings, new task objects or objects in unseen locations such as near a sink. The three levels that correspond to the three tasks of restocking, preparing a snack and fetching a lost object in the real kitchen are depicted in the last row of Fig. 4. Example trajectories for different levels are presented in the Appendix in Fig. 11.

blocks.en: We find in Table 4 that for RT-1, we do not lose performance adding simulation data compared to the Real Only dataset. We do however, see a significant increase in performance (from 23% to 87%) on objects and tasks seen only in simulation, to approximately the performance of the those in real, demonstrating an impressive degree of domain transfer. We also see a significant increase in performance on unseen instructions from 7% to 33%; impressive given the object in question has never been seen in real and the instruction never seen at all. Overall, we find that RT-1 is able to efficiently absorb new data, even from a very different domain.
blocks.zh: 从表 4 可以看出，与“仅真实数据”（Real Only）数据集相比，RT-1 在添加仿真数据后性能并无损失。然而，我们确实看到仅在仿真中见过的物体和任务上的性能大幅提升（从 23% 提升至 87%），几乎达到了真实物体和任务的表现水平，展示了出色的领域迁移能力。我们还看到未见指令的性能从 7% 显著提升到 33%；考虑到目标物体从未在现实中出现过且该指令此前完全未见，这一结果令人瞩目。总体而言，我们发现 RT-1 能够高效吸收新数据，即使这些数据来自截然不同的领域。

blocks.en: Absorbing data from different robots. To push the data absorption limits of RT-1, we conduct an additional set of experiments where we combine two data sources that originate from different robots: Kuka IIWA as well as the Everyday Robots mobile manipulators used in the experiments so far. The Kuka data contains all the successful examples collected in QT-Opt (Kalashnikov et al., 2018), which corresponds to 209k episodes, where the robot was indiscriminately grasping objects in a bin (see an example of a Kuka episode in Table. 5). To test whether RT-1 can effectively absorb these two very different datasets, which we refer to as the standard “Classroom eval”, as well as the performance on the newly constructed tasks that reflect the bin-picking setup present in the Kuka data, which we refer to as the “Bin-picking eval” (see Fig. 6).
blocks.zh: 吸收来自不同机器人的数据。为了进一步拓展 RT-1 的数据吸收极限，我们进行了一组额外的实验，将源自不同机器人的两个数据源进行结合：Kuka IIWA 以及迄今为止实验中使用的 Everyday Robots 移动操作机。Kuka 数据包含在 QT-Opt（Kalashnikov et al., 2018）中收集的所有成功样本，对应 20.9 万个回合（209k episodes），其中机器人从料筐中无差别地抓取物体（Kuka 回合示例见表 5）。为了测试 RT-1 能否有效吸收这两个截然不同的数据集，我们评估了其在原有环境中的表现（我们称之为标准“Classroom 评估”），以及在体现 Kuka 数据中料筐抓取设置的新建任务上的性能（我们称之为“Bin-picking 评估”，见图 6）。

blocks.en: We would like to emphasize the difficulty of this setting by noting the major differences between the datasets. Not only are the robots that collected the data different in appearance and action space, but also the environment they were deployed in has different appearance and dynamics. In addition the QT-Opt data presents a completely different action distribution – it was collected by an RL agent as opposed to human demonstrations present in our dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们希望通过指出数据集之间的主要差异来强调这一设置的难度。采集数据的机器人不仅在外观和动作空间上存在差异，而且它们所部署的环境在外观和动力学特性上也有所不同。此外，QT-Opt 数据呈现出截然不同的动作分布——它是由强化学习智能体采集的，而非像我们数据集中那样来自人类演示。

blocks.en: The results are presented in Table 5. blocks.en: 6.4 HOW DO VARIOUS METHODS GENERALIZE LONG-HORIZON ROBOTIC SCENARIOS?
blocks.zh: 6.4 各种方法如何在长程机器人场景中实现泛化？

blocks.en: In the next set of experiments we evaluate whether our method generalizes enough to be used in long-horizon realistic kitchen settings. To answer this question, we execute RT-1 and various baselines within the SayCan (Ahn et al., 2022) framework in two different real kitchens. Since SayCan combines many low-level instructions to perform high-level instructions, the number of possible high-level instructions increases combinatorially with skills, so the skill-breadth of RT-1 can be fully seen (for more details on the SayCan algorithm please refer to Ahn et al. (2022)). The success rate of long-horizon tasks also decreases exponentially with the length of the task, so high success rates in manipulation skills are particularly important. Furthermore, as mobile manipulation tasks require both navigation and manipulation, the policies ability to be robust to base position is crucial. More detail is provided in Appendix D.3.
blocks.zh: 在下一组实验中，我们评估我们的方法是否具有足够的泛化能力以应用于长程（long-horizon）真实厨房环境。为了回答这个问题，我们在两个不同的真实厨房中，在SayCan（Ahn et al., 2022）框架下运行了RT-1以及各种基线方法。由于SayCan结合了许多低层指令来执行高层指令，可能的高层指令数量随技能呈组合式增长，因此可以充分体现RT-1的技能广度（关于SayCan算法的更多细节，请参阅Ahn et al. (2022)）。长程任务的成功率还会随任务长度呈指数级下降，因此操作技能的高成功率尤为重要。此外，由于移动操作任务同时需要导航和操作，策略对底盘位置的鲁棒性至关重要。更多细节参见附录D.3。

blocks.en: - 6.5 HOW DO GENERALIZATION METRICS CHANGE WITH VARYING AMOUNTS OF DATA QUANTITY AND DATA DIVERSITY?
blocks.zh: - 6.5 泛化指标如何随数据量和数据多样性的变化而改变？

blocks.en: While previous works have shown the scaling abilities of Transformer-based models (Lee et al., 2022a; Reed et al., 2022; Jiang et al., 2022) with the number of model parameters, in many robotics works the model size is often not the primary bottleneck, and the maximum size is limited by the latency requirement for running such models on real robots. Instead, in this study we focus on ablating the influence of dataset size and diversity, as they play an important role in the traditionally data-limited robot learning field. Since data collection is particularly expensive for real robots, it is important to quantify what kind of data our models need to achieve a certain performance and generalization. Thus, our last question focuses on the scaling properties of RT-1 with different data properties.
blocks.zh: 虽然先前的研究已经展现了基于Transformer的模型随模型参数量增加的缩放能力（Lee et al., 2022a; Reed et al., 2022; Jiang et al., 2022），但在许多机器人研究中，模型规模往往不是主要瓶颈，其最大尺寸受到在真实机器人上运行此类模型的延迟要求的限制。相反，在本研究中，我们重点对数据集规模和多样性的影响进行消融实验，因为它们在传统上数据受限的机器人学习领域中起着重要作用。由于真实机器人的数据收集格外昂贵，量化我们的模型需要何种数据来达到一定的性能和泛化能力便显得至关重要。因此，我们的最后一个问题聚焦于RT-1在不同数据特性下的缩放特性。

As we decrease dataset size, we see a general trend of decreasing performance and a steeper trend of decreasing generalization. As we make the dataset more narrow, we see much steeper performance reductions, particularly in terms of generalization. In fact, removing 25% of the tasks while keeping 97% of the data achieves an equivalent generalization performance to reducing the dataset size by as much as 49%. Our key takeaway is thus that data diversity is more essential than data quantity.
blocks.zh: 100（37%的数据量）和50（22.5%的数据量）。为了构建一个窄分布的数据集，我们移除了数据量最少的任务，从而保留了97%的总数据量，但仅保留了75%的任务。随着我们缩减数据集规模，我们观察到了性能下降的普遍趋势，以及泛化能力下降更为陡峭的趋势。当我们使数据集变得更窄时，我们观察到了更为剧烈的性能下降，尤其是在泛化方面。事实上，在保留97%数据量的同时移除25%的任务，其导致的泛化性能下降等同于将数据集规模缩减高达49%。因此，我们的核心结论是：数据多样性比数据量更为关键。

blocks.en: 7 CONCLUSIONS, LIMITATIONS AND FUTURE WORK
blocks.zh: 7 结论、局限性与未来工作

blocks.en: We presented Robotics Transformer 1, RT-1, a robot learning method that can effectively absorb large amounts of data and scales with data quantity and diversity. We trained RT-1 on a large dataset of demonstrations containing over 130k episodes collected over the course of 17 months with 13 robots. In our broad set of experiments, we demonstrated that our method that can perform over 700 instructions at 97% success rate and effectively generalize to new tasks, objects and environments better than previously published baselines. We also demonstrated that RT-1 can successfully absorb heterogeneous data from simulation and other robot morphologies without sacrificing original-tasks performance and while improving generalization to new scenarios. Lastly, we showed how this level of performance and generalization allowed us to execute very long-horizon tasks in the SayCan (Ahn et al., 2022) framework, with as many as 50 steps.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Robotics Transformer 1（RT-1），这是一种能够有效吸收海量数据并随数据量与多样性扩展的机器人学习方法。我们在一个包含超过13万个episode的大型演示数据集上训练了RT-1，该数据集由13台机器人在17个月的时间内收集。在我们广泛的实验中，我们证明了我们的方法能以97%的成功率执行700多条指令，并且能比以往发表的基准更好地有效泛化到新任务、新物体和新环境。我们还证明了RT-1能够成功吸收来自仿真和其他机器人形态的异构数据，且不会牺牲原有任务的性能，同时还能提升对新场景的泛化能力。最后，我们展示了这种水平的性能和泛化能力如何使我们能够在SayCan（Ahn et al., 2022）框架下执行步数多达50步的超长程任务。

blocks.en: While RT-1 presents a promising step towards large-scale robot learning with an data-absorbent model, it comes with a number of limitations. First, it is an imitation learning method, which inherits the challenges of that class of approaches such as the fact that it may not be able to surpass the performance of the demonstrators. Second, the generalization to new instructions is limited to the combinations of previously seen concepts and RT-1 is not yet able to generalize to a completely new motion that has not been seen before. Lastly, our method is presented on a large but not very dexterous set of manipulation tasks. We plan to continue extending the set of instructions that RT-1 enables and generalizes to to address this challenge.
blocks.zh: 虽然RT-1在使用高数据吸收率模型进行大规模机器人学习方面迈出了充满希望的一步，但它仍存在若干局限性。首先，它是一种模仿学习方法，继承了该类方法的挑战，例如可能无法超越演示者的表现。其次，对新指令的泛化仅限于先前见过的概念的组合，RT-1尚无法泛化到此前从未见过的全新运动。最后，我们的方法是在一组规模庞大但灵巧性不高的操作任务上展示的。我们计划继续扩展RT-1所支持和能泛化到的指令集，以应对这一挑战。

blocks.en: As we explore future directions for this work, we hope to scale the number of robot skills faster by developing methods that allow non-experts to train the robot via directed data collection and model prompting. While the current version of RT-1 is fairly robust especially to distractor objects, its robustness to backgrounds and environments could be further improved by greatly increasing the environment diversity. We also hope to improve the reaction speeds and context retention of RT-1 through scalable attention and memory.
blocks.zh: 在探索这项工作的未来方向时，我们希望通过开发允许非专家通过有针对性的数据收集和模型提示来训练机器人的方法，从而更快地扩展机器人技能的数量。虽然当前版本的RT-1相当鲁棒，尤其是对干扰物，但通过大幅增加环境多样性，其对背景和环境的鲁棒性可以得到进一步提升。我们还希望通过可扩展的注意力机制和记忆机制，提高RT-1的反应速度与上下文保持能力。

blocks.en: To allow the research community to build on top of this work, we have open-sourced the code for RT14 , which we hope will provide researchers with a valuable resource for future research for scaling up robot learning.
blocks.zh: 为了让研究界能够基于这项工作进一步发展，我们开源了RT-1的代码4，希望这能为研究人员提供宝贵的资源，以开展未来扩大机器人学习规模的研究。

blocks.en: - C.1 MODEL INFERENCE
blocks.zh: - C.1 模型推理

blocks.en: In addition to the inference speed requirement, we need to ensure that our system outputs actions at a consistent frequency, avoiding jitter. To accomplish this, we introduce a fixed-time waiting mechanism that waits a certain amount of time (280ms, the max observed latency of all components) after the state, that was used to compute the next action, has been captured, but before applying the action, similarly to the procedure described by Xiao et al. (2020).
blocks.zh: 除了推理速度要求之外，我们还需要确保系统以恒定的频率输出动作，避免抖动。为了实现这一点，我们引入了一种固定时间等待机制：在用于计算下一个动作的状态被捕获之后、但在执行该动作之前，等待一段固定时间（280ms，即所有组件中观测到的最大延迟），该过程类似于Xiao et al. (2020)所描述的流程。

blocks.en: C.2 DATA COLLECTION AT SCALE.
blocks.zh: C.2 大规模数据收集。

blocks.en: Each of the robots autonomously approaches its station at the beginning of the episode and communicates to the operator the instruction that they should demonstrate to the robot. To ensure a balanced dataset as well as randomization of the scene, we created a software module responsible for sampling the instructions to be demonstrated as well as the randomization of the background configuration. Each of the robots tells the demonstrator how to randomize the scene and which instruction to demonstrate.
blocks.zh: 在每个episode开始时，每台机器人都会自主移动到其工位，并向操作员传达其应当向机器人演示的指令。为确保数据集的均衡性以及场景的随机性，我们开发了一个软件模块，负责对待演示指令进行采样以及对背景配置进行随机化。每台机器人都会告知演示者如何对场景进行随机化以及演示哪条指令。

blocks.en: Demonstrations are collected with direct line-of-sight between operator and robot using 2 virtual reality remotes. We map remote controls onto our policy action space to preserve consistency of the transition-dynamics. 3D position and rotational displacements of the remote are mapped to 6d displacements of the robot tool. The x, y position of the joystick is mapped to a turning angle and driving distance of the mobile base. We compute and track trajectories to the target poses that we obtain from the joystick commands.
blocks.zh: 演示数据是在操作员与机器人处于直视视线（line-of-sight）内的情况下，使用2个虚拟现实遥控手柄采集的。我们将遥控操作映射到策略的动作空间，以保持转移状态动力学（transition-dynamics）的一致性。遥控手柄的三维位置和旋转位移被映射为机器人工具末端的6自由度（6d）位移。操纵杆的x、y位置被映射为移动底盘的转角和行进距离。我们计算并跟踪由操纵杆指令所获取的目标位姿的轨迹。

blocks.en: C.3 MODEL SELECTION AT SCALE
blocks.zh: C.3 大规模模型选择

blocks.en: As robot learning systems become more capable and the number of instructions they can handle increases, evaluation of these models becomes difficult (Kalashnikov et al., 2021a; Jang et al., 2021). This is an important consideration not only for evaluating different model classes and data distributions during the development process, but also for selecting the most performant model checkpoints for a particular training run. While there have been a number of proposed solutions to this problem (Dud´ık et al., 2011; Irpan et al., 2019; Hanna et al., 2017), mostly known in the offline reinforcement learning literature as “off-policy evaluation”, it still remains an open research challenge to evaluate multi-task robot learning systems at scale.
blocks.zh: 随着机器人学习系统的能力日益增强及其能够处理的指令数量不断增加，对这些模型的评估变得困难（Kalashnikov et al., 2021a; Jang et al., 2021）。这不仅是在开发过程中评估不同模型类别和数据分布时的重要考量，也是为特定训练运行选取性能最佳的模型检查点时的关键问题。尽管针对该问题已有若干提议的解决方案（Dud´ık et al., 2011; Irpan et al., 2019; Hanna et al., 2017）——在离线强化学习文献中通常被称为“离线策略评估（off-policy evaluation）”——但在大规模下评估多任务机器人学习系统仍是一个悬而未决的研究挑战。

blocks.en: In this work, we propose leveraging simulation for “real to sim” transfer as a scalable tool that provides an approximate estimate of model performance during training across many real tasks. We run policies trained from real data in a simulator to test the full rollout performance. Note that all of our training data comes from the real world (except the experiment in Section 6.3), and the simulator is used only for model selection. To accomplish this, we expand the simulation environment proposed by Lee et al. (2022b) to support 551 of the tasks described in Section 5.2. For each of these tasks, we define a set of scene setup randomizations, robot pose randomizations, and success detection criteria. To bridge the visual distribution shift between the real world and the simulation, we train a RetinaGAN (Ho et al., 2020) model that transforms simulated images into realistic looking images. Then, we deploy policies trained on real data directly into these simulation environments by applying RetinaGAN visual transformations at each timestep and measuring rollout simulated task success rates.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提议利用仿真进行“现实到仿真（real to sim）”迁移，以此作为一种可扩展的工具，用于在训练期间针对众多真实任务粗略估计模型性能。我们在仿真器中运行使用真实数据训练的策略，以测试其完整的 rollout 表现。需要注意的是，我们所有的训练数据均来自现实世界（第 6.3 节中的实验除外），仿真器仅用于模型选择。为此，我们扩展了 Lee et al. (2022b) 提出的仿真环境，以支持第 5.2 节中描述的 551 项任务。对于这些任务中的每一项，我们都定义了一组场景布置随机化、机器人位姿随机化以及成功检测判定准则。为了弥合真实世界与仿真之间的视觉分布偏移，我们训练了一个 RetinaGAN (Ho et al., 2020) 模型，将仿真图像转换为逼真的图像。然后，我们通过在每个时间步应用 RetinaGAN 视觉变换并测量 rollout 的仿真任务成功率，将基于真实数据训练的策略直接部署到这些仿真环境中。

blocks.en: While models trained only on real world data perform better in the real world than they do in simulation, we find that the simulation success rates of high-performing real world policies are higher than the simulation success rates of low-performing real world policies. In other words, the ordering of simulation policy success rates are informative for predicting the ordering of real world policy success rates. We note that in this real-to-sim evaluation setting, we have a less strict requirement for simulation accuracy compared to sim-to-real settings; as long as simulation success rates are directionally correlated with real success rates, we can accept a moderate or even high gap between real and simulation success rates.
blocks.zh: 尽管仅在真实世界数据上训练的模型在现实世界中的表现优于在仿真中的表现，但我们发现，现实世界中高表现策略的仿真成功率要高于现实世界中低表现策略的仿真成功率。换句话说，仿真策略成功率的排序能够为预测现实世界策略成功率的排序提供有效信息。我们注意到，在这种现实到仿真的评估设置中，与仿真到现实迁移（sim-to-real）设置相比，我们对仿真精度的要求不那么严格；只要仿真成功率与真实成功率在趋势方向上具有相关性，我们便可以容忍真实成功率与仿真成功率之间存在中等甚至较大的差距。

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows the growth of data, number of tasks, and the success rate of the policy over time. blocks.en: D.1 EVALUATION DETAILS
blocks.zh: D.1 评估细节

blocks.en: In Section 6.2, we study the zero-shot generalization capabilities of RT-1 to difficult scenarios not present in the training dataset. To fairly evaluate different ablations of RT-1 as well as baseline policies, we design standardized evaluation procedures that cover a range of incremental difficulty levels.
blocks.zh: 在第 6.2 节中，我们研究了 RT-1 面对训练数据集中未出现的困难场景时的零样本泛化能力。为了公平评估 RT-1 的不同消融变体以及基线策略，我们设计了涵盖一系列递增难度等级的标准化评估流程。

blocks.en: Seen tasks. We evaluate on 744 tasks present in the training dataset. The breakdown between 12 skills is shown in Table 1. For all “Seen” evaluations, we use the same classroom setting used for data collection as described in Section 5.2. For each policy, we report a single representative metric that takes a skill-weighted average across individual skill evaluations.
blocks.zh: 见过的任务。我们对训练数据集中出现的 744 项任务进行了评估。表 1 展示了这 744 项任务在 12 项技能上的分布情况。对于所有“见过”的评估，我们采用如第 5.2 节所述用于数据收集的相同教室场景设置。对于每种策略，我们通过对各项单独技能的评估结果计算技能加权平均值，以此报告单一的代表性指标。

blocks.en: Unseen tasks. We evaluate policy performance on 53 tasks that are held out during training. While the unseen instructions’ specific combinations of skills and objects are not seen during training, other combinations of the same skills and objects are present in the training set. We evaluate these unseen tasks in the same environment and the same randomization procedure as the Seen tasks . A full list of these unseen tasks is shown in Table 8.
blocks.zh: 未见过的任务。我们在训练期间保留的 53 项任务上评估策略表现。虽然未见过指令中所涉及的技能与物体的特定组合在训练期间并未见过，但相同技能与物体的其他组合是存在于训练集中的。我们在与见过的任务相同的环境及相同的随机化流程下评估这些未见过的任务。这些未见过任务的完整列表如表 8 所示。

blocks.en: Distractor robustness. blocks.en: Realistic instructions. To study how RT-1 performs in more realistic scenarios, we propose an evaluation setting in a real office kitchen that is a dramatic shift from the original training classroom environment. We propose a variety of skills that combine aspects of the previous zero-shot evaluations, including adding new distractors, including new backgrounds, and new combinations of objects with skills. We refer to the easiest scenario as L 1 generalization, which introduces a new countertop and lighting condition but keeps the skills and objects the same. Next, L 2 generalization additionally adds novel distractor objects such as kitchen jar containers. Finally, L 3 generalization adds new objects or new locations such as near a sink. While some of these distribution shifts are tested in Section 6.2, these realistic instructions aim to test multiple dimensions simultaneously. Examples of these instructions are presented in Fig. 11.

To this end, we conduct two experiments: (1) RT-1 trained and tested on both real data and simulation data and (2) RT-1 trained across large datasets of different tasks, originally collected by different robots.
blocks.zh: 牺牲其在该数据所固有的各项任务上的原始任务性能。为此，我们开展了两项实验：(1) 在真实数据和仿真数据上同时训练并测试 RT-1，以及 (2) 在最初由不同机器人采集的、涵盖不同任务的大规模数据集上训练 RT-1。

blocks.en: Absorbing simulation data. Table 9 shows the ability of RT-1, and baselines, to absorb both real and simulation data. To test this, we take all of the real demonstration data but we also provide additional simulation data that includes objects that the robot has never seen in the real world. We add a set of sim objects and only show them on a subset of tasks, specifically the picking tasks, in simulation. To accomplish this, we run our real2sim method described in Sec. C.3 to bootstrap a simulation policy from the real world policy that is then trained with multi-task RL (Kalashnikov et al., 2021a) with additional objects in simulation. From this process, we extract 518k successful trajectories of picking new objects and mix them with the real data that was used in the previous experiments. The goal of this experiment is to demonstrate that by expanding the dataset of simulation trajectories, we can benefit RT-1’s generalization capabilities without sacrificing the original training performance – a desired property of an absorbent model.
blocks.zh: 吸收仿真数据。表 9 展示了 RT-1 及基线模型吸收真实数据和仿真数据的能力。为了测试这一点，我们采用了全部真实演示数据，但同时也提供了额外的仿真数据，其中包括机器人在现实世界中从未见过的物体。我们添加了一组仿真物体，并且仅在仿真环境中的一部分任务（具体为抓取任务）中展示它们。为实现这一点，我们运行了第 C.3 节中描述的 real2sim 方法，从现实世界策略中引导出一个仿真策略，随后在仿真环境中引入额外物体并通过多任务强化学习（Kalashnikov et al., 2021a）对其进行训练。在此过程中，我们提取了 518k 条抓取新物体的成功轨迹，并将其与先前实验中使用的真实数据进行混合。本实验的目标是证明，通过扩充仿真轨迹数据集，我们可以在不牺牲原始训练性能的前提下提升 RT-1 的泛化能力——这正是具备良好吸收能力的模型所期望的特性。

blocks.en: To evaluate the properties of this model, we specify different generalization scenarios: for seen skills with real objects the training data has real data of that instruction (i.e., performance on seen tasks), for seen skills with sim objects the training data has sim data of that instruction (e.g. “pick up a sim object”, which was present in sim), and for unseen skills with sim objects the training data has sim data of that object but there are no examples of the instruction describing the skill with that object either in sim or in real (e.g., “move a sim object to apple”, even though the robot has only practiced in picking that sim object and not moving it near other objects). All evaluations are done in the real world but to limit the number of instructions evaluated, we focus on pick and move-to skills.
blocks.zh: 为了评估该模型的特性，我们指定了不同的泛化场景：对于涉及真实物体的已见技能，训练数据包含该指令的真实数据（即在已见任务上的性能）；对于涉及仿真物体的已见技能，训练数据包含该指令的仿真数据（例如“拾取一个仿真物体”，该指令在仿真中出现过）；对于涉及仿真物体的未见技能，训练数据包含该物体的仿真数据，但在仿真或真实环境中均没有针对该物体描述该技能的指令样本（例如“将仿真物体移动到苹果旁”，尽管机器人仅练习过抓取该仿真物体，而未曾将其移动到其他物体附近）。所有评估均在真实世界中进行，但为了限制所评估指令的数量，我们重点关注抓取（pick）和移动至（move-to）技能。

blocks.en: We find in Table 9 that for RT-1, we do not lose performance adding simulation data compared to the Real Only dataset. We do however, see a significant increase in performance (from 23% to 87%) on objects and tasks seen only in simulation, to approximately the performance of the those in real, demonstrating an impressive degree of domain transfer. We also see a significant increase in performance on unseen instructions from 7% to 33%; impressive given the object in question has never been seen in real and the instruction never seen at all. Overall, we find that RT-1 is able to efficiently “sponge up” new data, even from a very different domain.
blocks.zh: 我们从表 9 中发现，对于 RT-1 而言，与仅使用真实数据（Real Only）的数据集相比，添加仿真数据并不会损失性能。然而，在仅在仿真中见过的物体和任务上，我们观察到了性能的大幅提升（从 23% 提升至 87%），几乎达到了在真实环境中见过的物体和任务的性能水平，展现出了令人瞩目的领域迁移程度。我们还看到在未见指令上的性能显著提升，从 7% 上升至 33%；考虑到相关物体从未在真实环境中出现过，且该指令也完全未曾见过，这一提升令人印象深刻。总体而言，我们发现 RT-1 能够高效地“海绵式吸收（sponge up）”新数据，哪怕数据来自截然不同的领域。

blocks.en: Absorbing data from different robots. To push the data absorption limits of RT-1, we conduct an additional set of experiments where we combine two data sources that originate from different robots: Kuka IIWA as well as the Everyday Robots mobile manipulators used in the experiments so far. The Kuka data contains all the successful examples collected in QT-Opt (Kalashnikov et al., 2018), which corresponds to 209k episodes, where the robot was indiscriminately grasping objects in a bin (see an example of a Kuka episode in Table. 10). Our goal in this experiment is to analyze whether the performance on the RT-1 tasks drops when adding the additional data and, more importantly, whether we can observe any transfer from data collected by a different robot morphology.
blocks.zh: 吸收来自不同机器人的数据。为了探究 RT-1 的数据吸收极限，我们开展了一组额外实验，将来自不同机器人的两个数据源进行结合：Kuka IIWA 以及此前实验中使用的 Everyday Robots 移动操作机。Kuka 数据包含了在 QT-Opt（Kalashnikov et al., 2018）中采集的所有成功样本，对应于 209k 个回合（episodes），其中机器人无差别地抓取料箱（bin）中的物体（参见表 10 中的 Kuka 回合示例）。我们在该实验中的目标是分析在添加额外数据时 RT-1 任务上的性能是否会有所下降，更重要的是，我们能否观察到来自不同机器人构型所采集数据的迁移效果。

blocks.en: We would like to emphasize the difficulty of this setting by noting the major differences between the datasets. Not only are the robots that collected the data different in appearance and action space, but also the environment they were deployed in has different appearance and dynamics. In addition the QT-Opt data presents a completely different action distribution – it was collected by an RL agent as opposed to human demonstrations present in our dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们希望通过指出数据集之间的主要差异来强调这种设置的难度。采集数据的机器人不仅在外观和动作空间上截然不同，而且它们所部署的环境在外观与动力学特性上也存在差异。此外，QT-Opt 数据呈现出完全不同的动作分布——它是由强化学习智能体（RL agent）采集的，而非我们数据集中所包含的人类演示。

blocks.en: To mix the Kuka data together with the RT-1 data, we first transform the original Kuka 4-DOF action space into the same action space as RT-1, namely we set the roll and pitch to 0, while keeping the yaw values that were present in the original Kuka data. In addition, we transform the binary gripper-close command into a continuous gripper-closedness command that is present in the RT-1 data. We also need text instructions corresponding to the task performed and since the Kuka data does not contain the name of the object that was grasped, we relabel all the data to the “pick anything” instruction. With these modifications, we mix both datasets with the 2:1 (RT-1 data : Kuka data) ratio and train RT-1 to obtain the final model.
blocks.zh: 为了将 Kuka 数据与 RT-1 数据混合，我们首先将原有的 Kuka 4 自由度（4-DOF）动作空间转换为与 RT-1 相同的动作空间，即将横滚（roll）和俯仰（pitch）设为 0，同时保留原始 Kuka 数据中存在的偏航（yaw）值。此外，我们将二值夹爪闭合指令转换为 RT-1 数据中存在的连续夹爪闭合度指令。我们还需要与所执行任务相对应的文本指令，由于 Kuka 数据不包含被抓取物体的名称，因此我们将所有数据重新标注为“抓取任意物体（pick anything）”指令。经过这些修改后，我们以 2:1 的比例（RT-1 数据 : Kuka 数据）混合这两个数据集并训练 RT-1，从而得到最终模型。

blocks.en: To test whether RT-1 can effectively absorb these two very different datasets, we evaluate the performance on the original RT-1 tasks (in this case, we also focus on “pick” and “move to” skills), which we refer to as the standard “Classroom eval”, as well as the performance on the newly constructed tasks that reflect the bin-picking setup present in the Kuka data, which we refer to as the “Bin-picking eval”. For the Bin-picking eval to be close to the original dataset, we put in the same looking bin for the objects as well as modify the robot to be similar to the Kuka manipulators by adding extra wires and coloring the gripper gray. For all of the evaluations we use the Everyday Robots robot with the picking commands and evaluate it based on 72 grasping trials.
blocks.zh: 为了测试 RT-1 是否能有效吸收这两个截然不同的数据集，我们评估了其在原始 RT-1 任务上的表现（在此情况下，我们同样重点关注“抓取”和“移动至”技能），我们称之为标准“教室评估（Classroom eval）”；同时评估了其在反映 Kuka 数据中料箱抓取设置的新构建任务上的表现，我们称之为“料箱抓取评估（Bin-picking eval）”。为了使料箱抓取评估贴近原始数据集，我们放置了外观相同的物体料箱，并通过添加额外线缆以及将夹爪涂成灰色，对机器人进行了改装以使其类似于 Kuka 操作机。在所有评估中，我们均使用 Everyday Robots 机器人执行抓取指令，并基于 72 次抓取试验进行评估。

blocks.en: The results are presented in Table 10. We observe that the model that mixes the RT-1 data and the Kuka data has only a minimal decrease in the original tasks’ performance (i.e. Classroom eval), i.e. 2%. Even more importantly, in the Bin-picking eval, we observe that the model trained on multirobot data performs at 39% compared to the 22% of the model that was trained only on the RT-1 data. This is a 17% performance difference (almost 2x). Additionally, RT-1 trained on Kuka bin-picking data and evaluated on the bin-picking tasks with the Everyday Robots (EDR) robot achieves 0% performance, confirming that it is difficult to transfer a behavior from another robot morphology. However, mixing the data from both robots allows RT-1 to infer the correct actions of the EDR robot even when faced with the states observed by Kuka robots. This is achieved without explicit demonstrations of bin-picking on EDR robot and by taking advantage of past experiences collected by Kuka robots. These results indicate that RT-1’s absorption properties also include the ability to

blocks.en: D.3 LONG-HORIZON EVALUATION DETAILS
blocks.zh: D.3 长视距评估细节

blocks.en: In addition to short-horizon individual skill evaluations shown in previous sections, we also evaluate how RT-1 performs in a long-horizon realistic kitchen setting that chains multiple manipulation and navigation skills to accomplish natural language instructions within the SayCan framework (Ahn et al., 2022). A list of long-horizon instructions used for these evaluations is listed in Table 12.
blocks.zh: 除了前述各节中展示的短视距单项技能评估外，我们还评估了 RT-1 在长视距真实厨房环境中的表现，该环境在 SayCan 框架（Ahn et al., 2022）内将多项操作和导航技能串联起来，以完成自然语言指令。用于这些评估的长视距指令列表见表 12。

blocks.en: The success rate of long-horizon tasks decreases exponentially with the length of the task, so high success rates in manipulation skills are particularly important. Furthermore, as mobile manipulation tasks require both navigation and manipulation, the policies ability to be robust to base position is crucial. Since SayCan combines many low-level instructions to perform high-level instructions, the number of possible high-level instructions increases combinatorially with instructions, so the skill-breadth of RT-1 can be fully seen.
blocks.zh: 长视距任务的成功率随任务长度呈指数级下降，因此操作技能的高成功率尤为关键。此外，由于移动操作任务同时需要导航与操作，策略对移动底盘位置的鲁棒性至关重要。由于 SayCan 组合了多个低层指令来执行高层指令，可能的高层指令数量会随指令呈组合式增长，从而使 RT-1 的技能广度得以充分展现。

blocks.en: SayCan works by grounding language models in robotic affordances and it leverages few-shot prompting to break down a long horizon task expressed in natural language to a sequence of low level skills. An example of long horizon task would be “Bring me two different sodas”, and one feasible plan would be “1. find a coke, 2. pick up the coke, 3. bring it to you, 4. put down the coke, 5. find a pepsi, 6. pick up the pepsi, 7. bring it to you, 8. put down the pepsi, 9. done.” To obtain the affordance function we use value functions trained with MT-OPT (Kalashnikov et al., 2021a). For a detailed description of SayCan algorithm please refer to (Ahn et al., 2022).
blocks.zh: SayCan 的工作原理是将语言模型锚定于机器人示能（affordances）中，并利用少样本提示（few-shot prompting）将用自然语言表达的长视距任务分解为一系列低层技能。长视距任务的一个示例是“给我拿两罐不同的苏打水”，一个可行的规划是“1. 找到可乐，2. 拿起可乐，3. 把它带给你，4. 放下可乐，5. 找到百事可乐，6. 拿起百事可乐，7. 把它带给你，8. 放下百事可乐，9. 完成。”为了获取示能函数（affordance function），我们使用通过 MT-OPT（Kalashnikov et al., 2021a）训练的价值函数。关于 SayCan 算法的详细说明，请参阅（Ahn et al., 2022）。

blocks.en: Since the focus of this paper is acquisition of many generalizable skills, we focus our evaluation on one subset of tasks presented in Ahn et al. (2022). It is the long-horizon family of tasks, involving 15 instructions, each instruction requires an average of 9.6 steps to complete, and involves an average of 2.4 manipulation skills per instruction. A full list of the instructions can be found in Table 12.
blocks.zh: 由于本文的重点是习得多种可泛化技能，因此我们将评估重点放在 Ahn et al. (2022) 中提出的一个任务子集上。这是一个长视距任务族，共包含 15 条指令，每条指令平均需要 9.6 个步骤完成，且每条指令平均涉及 2.4 项操作技能。完整的指令列表见表 12。

blocks.en: We compare against 3 baselines. 1) SayCan with BC-Z, which uses SayCan planning algorithm with BC-Z as manipulation policy, 2) SayCan with Gato, which uses SayCan planning algorithm with Gato as manipulation policy, 3) Originally reported SayCan results, which use SayCan planning algorithm with BC-Z, but since it uses a slightly different prompt, the planning success rate is lower. We reimplemented 3) in 1) for a fair comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们与 3 种基线进行了对比：1) 搭配 BC-Z 的 SayCan，采用 SayCan 规划算法并以 BC-Z 作为操作策略；2) 搭配 Gato 的 SayCan，采用 SayCan 规划算法并以 Gato 作为操作策略；3) 最初发表的 SayCan 结果，采用 SayCan 规划算法搭配 BC-Z，但由于使用了略有不同的提示（prompt），其规划成功率较低。为了公平对比，我们在 1) 中重新实现了 3)。
